info.name: Montran Corporate Payments Portal Account Information Account Structures API

items.docs: Retrieves virtual account hierarchy structures. Account structures define the organizational grouping of virtual accounts for corporate clients, enabling POBO/COBO, in-house banking, and treasury centralization use cases.

Creates a new virtual account hierarchy structure mapping virtual accounts to physical bank accounts. Supports multi-bank, multi- currency structures for POBO/COBO, in-house banking, and escrow use cases.
